purpose: Integrate BPM physical-market evidence and HBP systemic evidence as a typed causal graph without pooling likelihoods, posteriors, scores, weights or authority.

is: a registry of campaign-local evidence states
a typed graph of contextual and homologous relations
a common state machine for freeze, outcome, adjudication, posterior, Z_post and future prior
a mechanism for preserving support gaps, abstentions and adverse gates
is_not: a global score, ranking or winner
a mechanism for translating support or authority between jurisdictions
a substitute for first-release vintage custody

causal_order: freeze exactly the next comparable temporal unit
capture the official first-release outcome as immutable bytes
adjudicate within the same target and jurisdiction
update the campaign-local posterior exactly once
derive only the next future prior and freeze

typed_edges.permitted_use: joint descriptive diagnostics and preregistered future covariates only
future preregistered observer only after payload recovery and calendar alignment
methodological comparison after separate local adjudications
future preregistered lagged observer only after complete-panel custody
hypothesis generation only; no current inferential authority

compatible_controls: posterior learning only toward future runs
constitutional_candidate.lineage_limit: the observable linked trunk does not independently establish primary BayME-EVE origin

current_position.scientific_advance: comparability of heterogeneous evidence states and explicit causal gates, not an aggregate performance claim

next_decision_gate: adjudicate the earliest official first release among Luke August, Argentina IPI July, Argentina UCII July and Eurostat STS Spain July while preserving every frozen target and local posterior.
